cases.purpose: Exercise no-act, exact erasure of ext and swap magic through a disposable loop block node, and silent repeat.
cases.oracle: Independent synthetic format magic offsets and a full device byte comparison against a saved original; documented builtin output.
cases.comparison: Exact builtin output, status, and empty stderr; complete device bytes before and after erasure.

files.device-bytes.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
import os, pathlib, sys
mode, image, device = sys.argv[1:]
page = os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE')
if not 4096 <= page <= 1048576:
    raise SystemExit('unsupported guest page size')
if mode == 'seed':
    data = bytearray([0xa5]) * 1048576
    data[0x438:0x43a] = b'\x53\xef'
    data[page-10:page] = b'SWAPSPACE2'
    pathlib.Path(image).write_bytes(data)
else:
    expected = bytearray(pathlib.Path(image).read_bytes())
    if mode == 'erased':
        expected[0x438:0x43a] = bytes(2)
        expected[page-10:page] = bytes(10)
    with open(device, 'rb') as f:
        actual = f.read()
    if actual != expected:
        raise SystemExit('device bytes differ from ' + mode + ' expectation')

cases.script:
set -eu
work=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d /tmp/wipefs-device-contract.XXXXXXXX)
d=
cleanup() {
  if [[ -n $d ]]; then /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$d" || exit 1; fi
  /usr/bin/rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py seed "$work/image" unused
/usr/bin/cp "$work/image" "$work/original"
d=$(/usr/sbin/losetup --find --show "$work/image")
[[ -b $d ]] || { echo 'loop setup failed' >&2; exit 1; }
page=$(/usr/bin/getconf PAGESIZE)
printf '0x%x\tswap\t%s\n0x438\text\t%s\n' "$((page - 10))" "$d" "$d" > "$work/expected"
wipefs -a -n "$d" > "$work/out" 2> "$work/err"
/usr/bin/cmp "$work/expected" "$work/out"
test ! -s "$work/err"
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py original "$work/original" "$d"
wipefs -a "$d" > "$work/out" 2> "$work/err"
/usr/bin/cmp "$work/expected" "$work/out"
test ! -s "$work/err"
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py erased "$work/original" "$d"
wipefs -a "$d" > "$work/out" 2> "$work/err"
test ! -s "$work/out" && test ! -s "$work/err"
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py erased "$work/original" "$d"
printf 'device byte contract ok\n'
